subject: Users can't log in
description: Users can't log in. Everything is down. Need someone on the phone now.
hard_because: Sev1 language but unactionable content: no product, environment, error text or user count. Escalate for information-gathering, not for severity.

subject: Intermittent Access Denied on first attempt
description: Since Tuesday, roughly 4% of users are getting Access Denied on first attempt but succeed on retry. No config changes on our side. Not urgent, but the help desk volume is growing.
hard_because: Customer downgrades it themselves. Intermittent partial failure across a large user base is a genuine Sev2 - typically replication lag or time sync drift in progress.

subject: RADIUS integration broken
description: Our RADIUS integration is broken. The NAS shows timeouts to the Authentication Manager.
hard_because: Reads as RADIUS/Authentication. Timeouts observed at the NAS are usually firewall, routing or MTU, not the auth service itself.

subject: SAML errors after IdP metadata refresh
description: Getting SAML errors after our IdP metadata refresh last night. SSO to three internal apps is failing for all users.
hard_because: Total outage, so Sev1 by impact, but the cause is known and the fix path is obvious. High severity does not imply escalation.

subject: LDAP documentation request
description: Can you send me the documentation for configuring an LDAP identity source? Also our test environment cert expires next month.
hard_because: Two unrelated requests in one ticket with different categories. Tests whether the model latches onto the second sentence.

subject: Token codes rejected for one user
description: Token codes are being rejected for one user. She says the app is showing codes normally. Other users on the same device type are fine.
hard_because: Single user, low impact, but the pattern points to token clock drift rather than user error. Correctly low priority despite sounding alarming to the customer.

subject: URGENT production down
description: URGENT - production down - please escalate to management immediately. Submitted at 03:00 with no further detail.
hard_because: Maximum urgency language with zero information. Escalation is warranted; a Sev1 label is not, until impact is confirmed.

subject: Operations Console times out after upgrade
description: After the upgrade to the latest release, the admin console loads but the Operations Console times out. Authentication itself is unaffected.
hard_because: The words upgrade and times out suggest high severity. End users are unaffected - admin-only impact.

subject: Replication node not responding
description: We're seeing 'node not responding' in replication status between primary and replica. Auth is still working through the primary.
hard_because: No user-visible impact yet, but the failure domain is now a single node. Priority reflects risk, not current symptoms.

subject: Certificate renewal procedure
description: Our security team flagged that the web tier certificate expires in 6 days. What's the renewal procedure?
hard_because: Phrased as a documentation request. There is a hard deadline with a full outage on the other side of it.

subject: Agent stopped working after patching
description: Authentication agent on one of our Windows servers stopped working after patching. We've reinstalled twice.
hard_because: Reinstalled twice signals customer frustration and a likely non-obvious cause, but impact is limited to one server.

subject: Slow logins in Singapore office
description: Users in the Singapore office report slow logins - 15 to 40 seconds. Everywhere else is normal.
hard_because: Regional and degraded but still functional. Usually an identity source lookup or network path issue rather than the auth product.

subject: Bulk import 2000 users before Monday
description: We need to add 2,000 users before Monday's launch. What's the fastest bulk import method?
hard_because: Not a fault at all, but a business deadline is attached. Tests whether the model conflates deadline pressure with severity.

subject: Self-service password reset generic error
description: Self-service password reset returns a generic error for some users. We think it started after the AD schema change but we're not certain.
hard_because: Customer states a probable cause with explicit uncertainty. Escalate because the stated cause is likely wrong and will misdirect triage.

subject: Wrong policy applied in Cloud Authentication
description: Cloud Authentication Service is showing the wrong policy for a subset of users. They're getting MFA prompts they shouldn't get.
hard_because: An over-permissive prompt sounds harmless. Policy misapplication in the other direction would be a security finding, so the root cause matters.

subject: Logging yesterday's outage for the record
description: Everything works fine now. We just wanted to log that we had a 20-minute authentication outage yesterday around 14:00. No action needed.
hard_because: Customer explicitly says no action needed. An unexplained production auth outage always warrants root cause analysis.

subject: Identity Router lost cloud connection
description: The Identity Router lost connection to the cloud tenant. Failover worked so users aren't impacted, but we're running on the secondary.
hard_because: Users aren't impacted invites a low label, but there is no redundancy remaining.

subject: Successful auth from unrecognized IP range
description: Can someone explain why our logs show successful authentications from an IP range we don't recognize?
hard_because: Calm, question-shaped phrasing describing a possible compromise. The single most important case in the set to classify correctly.
